Pending issuance of the Notice to Proceed, the Subcontractor shall proceed with all other work authorized or required by the Subcontract in preparation for performing the work including, but not limited to, completion and submission of administrative submittals as identified in SNAP SPECIAL PROVISIONS, SUBMITTALS Section and other submittals as authorized or required by the Subcontract. All submittals shall be suitable for LLNS’ review and shall be in compliance with the Subcontract, specifications and other incorporated documents. All submittals shall be provided to LLNS within 7 calendar days from the date of award. The work shall be completed within 30 calendar days after the Notice to Proceed effective date. B. It is agreed that time is of the essence for this Subcontract and definite and certain lengths of time have been fixed for performance. Work shall be prosecuted regularly, diligently, and uninterruptedly at such rate of progress as will insure completion thereof within the time specified. The date of beginning, rate of progress, and time for completion are reasonable and essential conditions of this Subcontract. No act of forbearance by LLNS or extension by LLNS of the time for performance of this Subcontract shall in any way constitute or operate as a waiver of or excuse for any future default by the Subcontractor. No such action by LLNS shall constitute a waiver, release, or relinquishment of any of the rights or power herein conferred upon LLNS. C. In order to meet the construction completion schedule, it is necessary that the Subcontractor and all tiered subcontractors (including suppliers) maintain an aggressive approach to procurements, production and construction. Overtime work, weekend work, multiple shifts, accelerated material procurement, accelerated shop drawings, vendor data and submittals, and other actions may be required to meet the milestones contained in the construction schedule. ARTICLE 4 - PRICE LLNS will pay the Subcontractor a fixed price in the amount of $148,000.00 for the performance of this Subcontract. This price shall constitute full payment for the work, materials, services, and other items required by the Subcontract. This price includes all applicable federal, state, and local taxes, duties and all the Subcontractor's other obligations under this Subcontract.
